name: call_through_unresolved_table
description: Performs an indirect call through a jump table whose entries the analysis could not resolve, then returns. It has no other work, and its only caller is an unnamed routine.

name: invoke_method_and_flag_record
description: Brackets a dispatch-table method call between two system traps, sets bit zero of a status byte in its record, and if a global value does not exceed a byte field of the record, sets the global to nine. The analysis also lists a CIA control register as touched.

name: call_external_routine_between_traps
description: Calls, through an address register, a routine whose target cannot be identified from this code. It runs trap three, then the call, then trap seven, then trap four.

name: save_state_and_unlink_node
description: Inside a trap bracket, either calls a dispatch-table method and clears a status bit, or saves the caller's registers and stack words into a record, walks a linked list to find the matching node, unlinks it, and returns a value from it.

name: dequeue_node_after_saving
description: Between traps five and six, saves the caller's registers and stack words into a record, calls a method found through the object's dispatch table, then unlinks the matching list node and returns a value from it.

name: query_then_call_or_count
description: Between traps three and four, asks a dispatch-table method for a result; if the result is zero it calls a second method, otherwise it increments a 16-bit counter in the record.

name: invoke_dispatch_method_and_trap
description: Calls a method from a fixed slot of the object's dispatch table, then ends with trap four. It does no other work.

name: forward_to_dispatch_method
description: Calls one method from a fixed slot of the object's dispatch table and returns, doing nothing else.

name: enable_copper_list_dma
description: Starts the copper list through the copper-start helper, then writes enable values to the DMA and interrupt control registers and strobes the copper jump register before returning.

name: return_without_work
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. It is referenced by address, so it can serve as an empty callback target.

name: install_interrupt_handler
description: Calls a dispatch-table method, stores its result, sets a flag bit in the record, stores a handler address in a global, and writes an enable value for one interrupt source to the interrupt enable register.

name: increment_then_dispatch
description: Increments a global counter, then calls a method from a fixed slot of the object's dispatch table, and passes the original data registers back to its caller.

name: call_method_between_traps
description: Calls a dispatch-table method from a fixed slot between traps five and six, then returns.

name: invoke_late_slot_method
description: Calls a dispatch-table method from a later slot between traps five and six, then returns.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls a single other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: generate_random_word_table
description: Fills a table of 128 words at a fixed address with values from a linear congruential generator that multiplies the previous value by 171, takes the remainder modulo 30323, and adds one. It then clears a global and records the last generated value.

name: update_table_entry_from_generator
description: Advances the same generator by one step and stores into a table entry, chosen by an index held in the table, the new value plus two other table entries, after adjusting the low bytes of two stored words.

name: copy_buffer_and_setup_list
description: Copies a block of bytes backwards from a fixed source into a buffer, fills a table of 90 words with offsets from the buffer base, calls a helper, and calls it again for each list entry whose field is zero.

name: copy_rebased_table_to_record
description: Fetches a record's data block, creating it if missing, then either stores the block pointer directly when a flag is negative or copies a 90-word table into a buffer with each entry rebased, and stores the pointer in the target field.

name: process_fixup_command_list
description: Walks a command list in a record: negative entries copy a long word from a table into a pointer, positive entries compute a word from the base and store it, and the walk stops at a zero entry or a negative computed value. The decompiled tail is incomplete.

name: create_two_records_and_scan
description: Creates two linked records from a shared header, bumping a count in that header each time and copying fields from fixed globals into each record. It then walks a fixed list and calls a routine for each entry whose first field is zero.

name: store_method_result_in_record
description: Makes sure a referenced record is initialized, calls a dispatch-table method, and stores the returned value and a field of the referenced record into the target record.

name: select_register_object_and_release
description: Picks an object from one of several address registers according to a three-bit selector read from the caller's data. If that object's flag bit is clear, it calls the object's release method and decrements the object's count, then calls a finishing helper.

name: release_object_in_a0
description: If the object held in address register zero lacks its flag bit, calls a method from its dispatch table and decrements its count. It then calls a finishing helper.

name: release_object_in_a1
description: If the object held in address register one lacks its flag bit, calls a method from its dispatch table and decrements its count. It then calls a finishing helper.

name: release_object_in_a2
description: If the object held in address register two lacks its flag bit, calls a method from its dispatch table and decrements its count. It then calls a finishing helper.

name: release_object_in_a3
description: If the object held in address register three lacks its flag bit, calls a method from its dispatch table and decrements its count. It then calls a finishing helper. Three other routines call it.

name: install_interrupt_vectors_and_enable
description: Writes disabling masks to the CIA interrupt control registers and copies a block of handler addresses into the low-memory interrupt vector table. It then clears two globals and writes the master interrupt-enable value to the interrupt enable register.

name: clear_masked_status_and_enable
description: Clears from a status global the bits set in a data-register mask, then writes the master interrupt-enable value to the interrupt enable register. The analysis also lists the CIA-A interrupt control register as touched.

name: clear_masked_status_cia_b
description: Clears from a status global the bits set in a data-register mask, then writes the master interrupt-enable value to the interrupt enable register. The analysis lists the CIA-B interrupt control register as touched.

name: dispatch_upper_interrupt_levels
description: Reads the interrupt enable and request registers, keeps the upper three interrupt-level bits that are both enabled and pending, and calls a handler through a global pointer for each level found, testing the highest level first.

name: service_pending_cia_interrupts
description: Derives a pending-bit mask from a status global and, when any bit is set, calls a handler through a global pointer for each successive bit position it tests. The analysis lists the CIA-A interrupt control register and the interrupt request register as touched.

name: dispatch_lower_interrupt_levels
description: Reads the interrupt enable and request registers, keeps the lowest three interrupt-level bits that are both enabled and pending, and calls up to three handlers through a global pointer, testing each bit in turn.

name: invoke_handler_with_sign_retries
description: Calls a handler through a global pointer and, depending on the sign of the value it returns, calls it again up to two more times.

name: invoke_handler_retry_on_sign
description: Calls a handler through a global pointer and calls it a second time when bit six of the returned value is set.

name: call_handler_and_return
description: Calls a handler through a global pointer and returns the value it passes back.

name: increment_global_counter
description: Adds one to a global counter. The analysis lists the interrupt enable register as touched, but the code shown only increments the global.

name: decrement_global_counter
description: Decrements a global counter by one and, when the result is zero, sets the top bit of that global. Writing that value to the interrupt enable register enables interrupts.

name: return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns at once. It works as an empty placeholder routine.

name: traverse_signed_table
description: Walks a linked list of signed table entries that starts at a fixed address, advancing by an offset stored with each entry. It calls another routine for each non-negative entry it reaches before the zero entry that ends the walk.

name: iterate_table_and_call
description: Walks a short table in a record until a negative sentinel, calling another routine for each non-negative entry whose referenced value is also non-negative. It then invokes a handler stored in the record and sets the record's state word to minus one.

name: build_two_digit_text_rows
description: Clears a block of 1920 words, runs a long sequence of helper and hardware-wait calls, and converts a block of byte values into rows of encoded two-digit text. The decompiled output is truncated, so later parts of the routine are not described.

name: position_active_list_objects
description: Walks a linked list of objects and, for each object with an active flag and no pending link, computes two screen-position words from a byte table and calls helpers, with loops that wait on a status flag. The decompiled output is truncated, so the rest of the routine is not described.

name: invoke_extended_dispatch_method
description: Calls a method from a later slot of the object's dispatch table and returns.

name: compute_clamped_object_position
description: Calls a helper, then computes two position words for an object from table bytes, clamping each to a range. It chooses one of two stored values for another word by a threshold, sets a bit in a flags long from a table byte, and calls one of two helpers depending on a high bit.

name: insert_value_into_sorted_table
description: Inserts a value into a descending table of records, shifting lower records down and moving a 16-byte block with each. It then converts a value to decimal digits using packed-decimal arithmetic and copies a short text block into the display; the decompiled output is incomplete at the end.

name: encode_bytes_as_text_digits
description: Converts four source bytes into eight encoded digit characters, writing the high and low nibble of each byte with the ASCII digit offset and a fixed XOR. Leading zero digits are written as blanks.

name: copy_block_and_set_flag
description: If a block pointer is set, sets the top flag bit on the block, copies 32 long words from an offset inside it to the destination pointer, and calls a helper.

name: translate_symbol_through_table
description: Advances a counter and stores the next value in a buffer, then searches a 27-entry table for the current symbol and maps it through a second table to a substitute byte. The result is written to three output arrays.

name: stream_words_until_flag_clear
description: Repeats a pass that calls a helper for each of 321 words and stores each result into a buffer, until a global flag becomes zero. It then restores a saved word.

name: call_external_helper_only
description: Calls a fixed external helper and returns. It has no other logic.

name: call_external_helper_only
description: Calls a fixed external helper and returns. It has no other logic.

name: copy_block_then_stream_words
description: Copies 321 words from a source buffer into a destination, then repeats a pass that calls a helper for each of 321 words and stores the results into a buffer while a global flag stays non-zero.

name: switch_mode_when_changed
description: When a requested mode differs from the current one, releases stored blocks, runs a loop over a range of entries, and either reloads a large block of words from a fixed table or runs an alternate loop. It repeats until the stored mode matches the requested one.

name: dispatch_input_by_bit_four
description: Adds a fixed offset to an input character and tests bit four of the result. When the bit is clear it calls nine routines in sequence; when the bit is set it saves a status global, waits for a status change, and restores the saved status after a helper call.

name: save_wait_restore_status
description: Saves a status global, sets its low bit, and waits in a loop until another global becomes non-zero. It then clears the low bit and restores the saved status after a helper call.

name: clear_flag_bits_in_table
description: Walks a table of four-word entries until a minus-one sentinel, clearing two bit positions in each entry's flag byte. The bit positions come from two bytes of a record.

name: clear_flag_bit_in_table
description: Walks a table of four-word entries until a minus-one sentinel, clearing one bit in each entry's flag byte. The bit position comes from a byte of a record.

name: load_relocated_header_block
description: Copies a header block of 61 long words, converting each non-zero offset to an absolute address by adding the block base, then copies 24 further words. If the signature word does not match a fixed value, it runs an init routine and returns its status.

name: relocate_short_header_block
description: Copies a header block of six long-word offsets, converting each non-zero offset to an absolute address by adding the block base, then copies 18 further words.

name: sort_pointer_list_by_value
description: Sorts a list of pointers in place by comparing the word each pointer refers to, using a gap that halves on each pass. It also stores each list entry's own address in its link field.

name: return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns at once. It works as an empty placeholder routine.

name: swap_double_buffer_pointers
description: Clears the top bit of a flag byte in a record and, if that bit was set, clears a bit in a global. It then swaps two stored pointers used for double buffering and clears another bit of a global. The analysis lists the copper location register as touched.

name: swap_alternate_buffer_pointers
description: Clears the top bit of a flag byte in a record and, if that bit was set, clears a bit in a global. It then swaps a stored pointer with its alternate and clears another bit of a global. The analysis lists the copper location register as touched.

name: wait_until_flag_clears
description: Sets two flag bits in a global, then repeatedly calls a method from a later dispatch-table slot until that flag bit clears.

name: wait_flag_then_swap_buffers
description: Repeats a dispatch-table call while a flag bit is set, then swaps two stored pointers and sets another flag bit in a global.

name: swap_pointers_and_set_flag
description: Swaps two stored pointers used for alternate buffers and sets bit four of a global.

name: forward_to_late_dispatch_method
description: Calls a method from a late slot of the object's dispatch table and returns.

name: run_helper_sequence_then_handler
description: Calls a series of helpers around a decrement of a global counter, then calls a handler through a global pointer.

name: decrement_and_run_helper_chain
description: Calls a series of helpers around a decrement of a global counter, then calls a handler through a global pointer.

name: run_helpers_wait_on_flag
description: Calls a series of helpers, writes a status value to a global, and waits in a loop until a flag bit is set and then clears it. It then calls more helpers and a final routine.

name: initialize_table_if_empty
description: If a pointer global is unset, copies 1932 words from a fixed source into its buffer and calls helpers. It then calls several more helpers and sets bit four of a global.

name: clear_flag_and_release_buffer
description: Calls a helper, clears bit four of a global, and when bit eight is clear calls a release routine and zeroes the global.

name: clear_masked_entries_and_init
description: Stores a set of initial constants in globals, then walks six table entries and zeroes each non-negative entry whose bit is set in a mask derived from a value.

name: coalesce_adjacent_memory_blocks
description: Marks a memory block as in use and merges it with free neighbouring blocks by inspecting their size headers and updating their flag words. It then clears the pointer global and adjusts a size value.

name: reset_eight_slot_table
description: Points a global at a table, sets a count word to eight, then clears the first long word of each of eight entries and sets the second to a fixed value.

name: program_blitter_from_tables
description: Copies parameter tables into a buffer, sets a list of plane pointers, and programs the blitter's mask, modulo, pointer, control and size registers. It then waits on a busy flag before returning; the decompiled output does not show the end of the routine.

name: store_pointer_and_fill_offsets
description: Stores the pointer just past a buffer's first word into a record, saves the word before it, writes a fixed marker value into that word, and fills four table long words, each stepping by a fixed increment.

name: fill_table_with_stepped_values
description: Fills a run of long words starting at a pointer with values rising by a fixed step of 128, for a count taken from a global.

name: call_helper_and_store_result
description: Calls a helper and stores the value it returns into a global.

name: release_block_and_clear_pointer
description: Calls a release helper and then sets a global pointer to zero.

name: allocate_block_and_offset
description: Calls a helper, stores the value it returns in a global, then stores that value plus a fixed offset in the same global.

name: release_block_and_reset_globals
description: Calls a release helper, then sets two globals to zero.

name: dispatch_list_entries_by_code
description: Walks a list of entries until one holds a negative value, calling a handler selected by a byte stored in each entry. It returns the value that ended the walk.

name: initialize_record_flags
description: Sets two byte fields of a record to one and clears a word field.

name: copy_long_word_and_mark
description: Copies a long word from one offset in a buffer to a slot four bytes further on, then sets a byte flag in a record to one.

name: decrement_counters_and_dispatch
description: Decrements a run of byte counters in each list entry's table, wrapping a value of minus 128 to zero, and calls a handler selected by a byte in the entry when its counter reaches zero. It returns the value of the last entry.

name: set_mask_bits_across_words
description: Sets the bits of a mask in a run of long words, walking backwards when a global is negative and forwards otherwise. It then zeroes or marks a global depending on the direction taken.

name: store_masked_offset_word
description: Stores into a buffer slot the bitwise OR of a mask with a value taken from the next slot plus a global shifted by a field of a record, reduced modulo a count from the record and scaled by 128.

name: store_masked_offset_long
description: Stores into a buffer slot the bitwise OR of a mask with a value taken from the next slot plus a 32-bit value shifted by a field of a record, reduced modulo a count from the record and scaled by 128.

name: map_changed_bits_to_codes
description: Calls a dispatch-table method, compares its result with a previous state to find the bits that changed, and maps the set bits to fixed code values in sequence.

name: fill_pattern_rows_from_source
description: Fills rows of words in a buffer with a fixed sentinel value and a pattern word, copying scaled source entries into the middle rows. It calls helpers while it allocates and copies, and returns the last word written.

name: fill_pattern_rows_and_return
description: Fills rows of words in a buffer with a fixed sentinel value and a pattern word, copying scaled source entries into the middle rows after a helper call. It returns the last word written.

name: clear_and_run_three_helpers
description: Clears a global, calls three helpers in sequence, and returns.

name: store_word_and_shifted_pairs
description: Stores the current global word and that word shifted right by four into two pairs of fields in a record.

name: step_position_toward_target
description: Moves two stored position values one step at a time toward a target, calling helpers at each step. It then fills a record with aligned and scaled coordinates and a computed address.

name: check_entries_overlapping_range
description: Computes a range from a record's fields and walks a table of 8-byte entries, calling a helper for each entry whose byte range overlaps it. It stops at the first entry beyond the range.

name: scan_entries_backward_for_overlap
description: Computes a range from a record's fields and walks backward through a table of 8-byte entries, calling a helper for each overlapping entry. It stops early at the first entry below the range.

name: clamp_and_step_record_coordinates
description: Clamps two coordinate fields of a record to lower limits, then increments each field one step at a time, calling a helper at each step until it reaches its original value.

name: check_entries_overlapping_vertical
description: Computes a vertical range from a record's fields and walks a table of entries, calling a helper for each entry whose range overlaps it. It stops at the first entry beyond the range.

name: check_entries_overlapping_region
description: Computes a range from a record's fields and walks a table of 8-byte entries in reverse, calling a helper for each entry whose two byte ranges overlap. It returns early at the first entry past the range.

name: create_object_from_template
description: Marks a slot in a record and, if the slot is free, builds a new object by copying a 77-word template, linking it into a global list, and setting its position fields from bytes of the source. It negates one field when a flag bit is set.

name: walk_table_calling_helper
description: Walks a table of four-word entries until a minus-one sentinel, calling a helper for each entry while decrementing a counter that stops at zero. It then zeroes a global.

name: compute_row_offset
description: Returns a record's 16-bit field multiplied by 208, which gives a byte offset for a row.

name: or_mask_into_row_words
description: ORs a mask word into 20 consecutive words starting at a pointer.

name: or_mask_into_column_words
description: ORs a mask word into 13 words spaced 104 bytes apart, walking down a column.

name: start_repeated_blits
description: Programs the blitter's control, mask and modulo registers, then repeats 208 times: it starts a blit of a fixed size and waits for the busy flag to clear.

name: start_repeated_blits_from_pointers
description: Programs the blitter's control, mask and modulo registers from two pointer inputs, then repeats 208 times: it starts a blit of a fixed size and waits for the busy flag to clear.

name: run_nested_tile_loop
description: Derives row and column counts from a global value, then runs nested loops over rows and cells, calling helpers for each cell.

name: return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns at once. It works as an empty placeholder routine.

name: compute_screen_byte_offset
description: Derives a row and a column from two input registers and combines them into a byte address in a buffer of 160 bytes per row. It then clears a global and sets another to sixteen.

name: shift_bits_into_plane_words
description: Shifts one bit from a 4-bit input into each of four stored words. Once every sixteen calls it writes the four words into a buffer and resets the counter, and it returns the input shifted right by four.

name: update_timer_and_copy_row
description: Counts a timer down and, when it reaches zero with bit four set, calls a handler. It then stores a doubled counter in two record fields, copies 22 bytes from a table into the record with a fixed stride, and toggles a flag bit according to parity.

name: fill_word_pairs_with_marker
description: Fills 176 pairs of words, writing a supplied value to one word of each pair and a fixed high-bit marker to the other. It then clears a global and calls a helper.

name: dispatch_by_state_index
description: Calls one of several routines from a table, chosen by bits of a state global, then returns.

name: set_state_and_return_mask
description: Sets a few state globals to fixed values and returns the input byte OR-ed with a mask.

name: build_index_grid_from_entries
description: Counts table entries up to a zero byte, pre-fills a word grid with minus-one values, and for each entry writes an index value into the grid at each position named by its run of bytes. It calls helpers for the table work and releases a buffer at the end.

name: process_flagged_entry_run
description: Sets the top flag bit on an entry, then for each index byte in the entry's run that refers to an unflagged entry, calls two helpers. It then clears the flag and calls a final helper.

name: read_indexed_table_word
description: Computes an offset from a row value, a column value and a global multiplier, then returns the word stored at that offset in a table.

name: record_minimum_table_entry
description: Compares a new value with the entry at a computed table position. If that entry is empty or larger than the new value, it stores the new value there and records a global index in a second table.

name: clear_flag_across_entries
description: Clears the top flag bit in each entry of a table, stepping eight bytes at a time, for a count taken from a global.

name: release_block_if_set
description: If a global pointer is set, calls a release helper, clears the pointer and returns the helper's result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: set_low_bit_if_nonzero
description: Sets bit zero of a global when the global is non-zero.

name: run_helpers_on_pending_flag
description: When a pending bit is set and a second bit is clear, clears the pending bit, calls four helpers, optionally recomputes a value from a record field, and sets two more flag bits.

name: set_global_and_call_helper
description: Sets a global to a small value, adds four to the value it refers to, and calls a helper.

name: run_helper_grid_passes
description: Initializes a global from a constant, stores a long word from the caller's data into another global, and calls four helpers in each of four passes.

name: run_helper_quad_loop
description: Calls four helpers per iteration in a loop whose count is held in a data register, then returns.

name: draw_clamped_helper_passes
description: Clamps a record's negated field to a range of one to ten, then calls pairs of helpers in a sequence of loops whose counts depend on that value and on a second record field. It finishes with a further run of helper pairs.

name: call_helper_pairs_by_field
description: Sets a global from a constant plus a value in memory, then calls helper pairs: up to seven from a clamped record field, followed by a fixed run of further pairs.

name: add_referenced_value_if_odd
description: If bit zero of a global was already set, adds the value a pointer register refers to to the global. Otherwise it sets bit zero.

name: copy_table_row_into_record
description: Copies a 16-byte row from a fixed table, selected by an index in a data register, into a record at every second byte.

name: update_state_flag_bits
description: Updates a set of state bits in a global according to the results of helper calls and the bits already set, setting or clearing bits one, two and three as needed.

name: advance_indexed_state_machine
description: Calls a routine selected from a table by a state global, updates state globals from its returned value, and advances a counter. It then looks up a next value in a small table and stores it, or stores a sentinel when the lookup reaches its marker.

name: decode_direction_bits
description: Decodes bits of a state global into two pairs of signed step values and returns them. It decrements a counter and calls a helper when the counter reaches zero.

name: negate_dispatch_method_result
description: Calls a method from a late dispatch-table slot and returns the negative of its result.

name: store_four_register_inputs
description: Stores the four incoming register values into four globals in order.

name: load_resource_into_buffer
description: Obtains a size from a dispatch-table method, allocates a buffer when needed, copies the entry's data into it in word steps, and then releases buffers and reference counts before returning a status byte.

name: skip_strings_and_dispatch
description: Reads a count from a table entry, skips that many null-terminated strings in a block, then calls a dispatch-table method and stores the global.

name: return_masked_dispatch_result
description: Calls a helper and a dispatch-table method, then returns zero if the method's result is negative, otherwise the result ORed with a fixed mask.

name: return_immediately
description: Does nothing and returns at once. It works as an empty placeholder routine.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls a single other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: store_state_word_and_clear
description: Stores a fixed address in a global and branches on its value. A zero value calls helpers, stores the global into a record field, zeroes two globals and clears a flag bit; a non-zero value stores it into a record field and calls a helper.

name: save_and_restore_global
description: Saves a global into a temporary, writes it back and returns. The routine has no visible effect.

name: copy_masked_words_by_bits
description: Walks the 32 bits of a mask. When the mask is below a threshold, each clear bit calls a helper and stores its result; otherwise each clear bit copies a word from one buffer to another. It returns the last word read.

name: blend_two_packed_colors
description: Interpolates two packed colour values by a weight taken from a data register, computing weighted sums of each channel and returning the blended result.

name: copy_words_into_two_tables
description: Copies 32 words from the caller's source into one table while storing a saved global value into a second table, and sets several globals to constants.

name: copy_table_with_constant_fill
description: Fills one 32-word table with the value a global held on entry, copies another 32-word table into a third, and clears a global.

name: copy_table_masked_by_bits
description: Fills a 32-word table with values from the caller's source, and copies a second table into a third entry by entry, skipping entries where the bit being shifted out of a value is set.

name: copy_words_with_bitmap_skips
description: Copies a run of words from one buffer to another, using bits shifted from a mask to decide when to advance the second buffer, and stops when the count runs out.

name: double_global_and_call_helper
description: If a global is non-zero, derives a doubled or summed value from it with a sign check, stores that in the global and calls a helper.

name: update_object_list_and_masks
description: Clears a set of table words, then walks a linked list of objects. For each active object it clears or sets mask bits in two buffers, advances its command stream through a dispatch table, and relinks or frees the object. The decompiled output is truncated, so the end of the routine is not described.

name: combine_masks_and_dispatch_entries
description: For each entry in sixteen lists, ORs words from two mask buffers over the entry's extent, masks the result with a bit selection, stores a combined value, and calls a handler selected by a field of the entry.

name: allocate_template_object
description: Increments a global counter, copies a 77-word template into a newly allocated block, stores the block's address in a global and in a record field, and calls a helper.

name: copy_sparse_entries_with_offsets
description: Walks a sorted list of table entries, copying each word into an output buffer at the offset the entry gives and adding values from a second buffer where present, and stops at a sentinel.

name: unpack_bit_packed_stream
description: Checks the first long word of a block against a fixed signature and, if it matches, unpacks the bit-packed stream backwards into an output buffer. It decodes literal bytes and copies repeated runs from earlier output.

name: read_bits_from_stream
description: Reads a fixed number of bits from a backward-moving bitstream one at a time and returns them packed into a word.

name: push_record_onto_list
description: Links a record onto the front of a list by saving the current head in its link field and making the record the new head.

name: remove_record_from_list
description: Removes a record from a singly linked list by finding its predecessor, relinking around it and clearing its link. It resets the head when the removed record was the head, and does nothing if the record is not in the list.

name: push_record_with_short_link
description: Links a record onto the front of a list through a link field two bytes in, making it the new head.

name: reset_state_and_call_helpers
description: Clears a state global, calls four helpers, and calls one more when bit two of the state is set.

name: run_helpers_with_halved_step
description: Clears a global, calls three helpers, adds a halved value to the global, then calls one more helper.

name: process_control_string
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string at a fixed address. Control bytes below 32 each call a handler chosen from a table, and other bytes are stored in a global and passed to a text routine.

name: process_control_string_at
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string passed in an address register. Control bytes below 32 call handlers from a table, and other bytes are passed to a text routine.

name: append_byte_to_buffer
description: Stores a byte in a buffer at the current index, then advances the index unless it has reached 300.

name: run_five_helpers
description: Calls five helpers in sequence and returns.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls a single other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: call_helper_then_return
description: Calls a single other routine and returns, with no other work.

name: parse_string_fields_with_sums
description: Walks a byte string at a fixed address, dispatching control bytes through a handler. For each run of other bytes it sums helper results and adds the sum to a global, with a particular separator byte ending each run.

name: dispatch_by_index_word
description: Calls a handler from a table, selected by a word held in a data register.

name: accumulate_helper_results_over_bytes
description: Repeatedly calls one of two helpers according to bit zero of a global, summing their results over the bytes of a string until a terminating byte is reached. It returns the sum minus the global.

name: load_word_from_pointer
description: Loads the 16-bit value that the address register points to into a global.

name: load_byte_from_pointer
description: Loads the byte that the address register points to into a global as an unsigned value.

name: clear_word_table_range
description: Clears a count of words in a fixed table, with the count taken from a record field, then calls a helper.

name: fill_table_with_descending_rows
description: Fills a table with values that start at a count times 320 and fall by 640 per entry, with the count taken from a record field, then calls a helper.

name: clear_second_word_table_range
description: Clears a count of words in a second fixed table, with the count taken from a record field, then calls a helper.

name: fill_table_with_decreasing_halves
description: Fills a table with values starting at half of a record field's value minus one and decreasing by one per entry, then calls a helper.

name: add_word_tables_into_third
description: Adds two fixed word tables element by element into a third table, with the count taken from a record field.

name: load_signed_byte_from_pointer
description: Loads the signed byte that the address register points to into a global.

name: load_signed_byte_from_pointer
description: Loads the signed byte that the address register points to into a global.

name: find_list_node_by_key
description: Walks a linked list for a node whose first long word equals the value an address register points to. When it finds one it sets a global to that node and calls three helpers.

name: load_byte_from_pointer
description: Loads the byte that the address register points to into a global as an unsigned value.

name: load_word_from_pointer
description: Loads the 16-bit value that the address register points to into a global.

name: find_entry_and_copy_block
description: Looks up a node in a linked list by a 16-bit key taken from an address register. When it finds one it clears a flag and copies a block of entries into a fixed buffer, either from the node's data or from a fixed pattern, and sets a flag when the pattern check passes.

name: return_immediately
description: Does nothing visible and returns at once.

name: set_global_low_bit
description: Sets bit zero of a global.

name: dispatch_by_preceding_byte
description: Reads the byte just before the address register's target, subtracts a fixed offset, scales the result to a table index and calls the routine stored there.

name: set_bits_in_two_bytes
description: Sets a bit mask in one byte addressed from one register and another mask in a byte addressed from a second register. The code then decodes as bad instruction data, so the routine is incomplete.

name: configure_cia_and_enable_interrupt
description: Writes two values to CIA-A registers, stores a handler address and some values in globals, and writes an enable value for one interrupt source to the interrupt enable register. The analysis also lists the CIA-A port register as touched.

name: call_two_helpers
description: Calls two helpers in sequence and returns the incoming data registers unchanged.

name: build_pointer_table_from_offsets
description: Fills a global table with base-plus-offset values read from a record, then fills eight further entries from a second run of offsets. It stores two more values and a scaled difference, then calls two helpers.

name: prefix_sum_when_unflagged
description: Sets the top bit of a flag byte. If that bit was clear and the pointer is set, it replaces each word of a run with the running sum of the values before it.

name: silence_audio_channels
description: Sets a few globals and writes zero to the volume register of each of the four audio channels, then sets bit one of a global. The analysis also lists the audio control and interrupt registers as touched.

name: select_best_candidate_value
description: Looks up a candidate value in a table indexed by an input byte. If it is at least as large as the value stored for the given slot, it stores the candidate and its index and returns the packed result. Otherwise it returns a sentinel of minus one.

name: advance_command_sequence
description: If a wait counter is running it decrements it. Otherwise it reads the next command word from the record; an end marker returns, and any other word is stored with the record's state fields cleared, its pointer set from a table entry, and a helper called.

name: advance_four_sequence_tracks
description: Advances up to four sequence tracks. Each track's timer counts down, and when it expires the routine reads the next command byte from its sequence. Commands set note, volume or period values in the track record, and a helper finishes the update.

name: run_four_channel_timers
description: Updates four channel records in turn. It counts down each channel's timer and, when it expires, dispatches the channel's next entry through a table, and it calls three helpers for channels with an additional timer set.

name: run_four_channel_timers
description: Updates four channel records in turn. It counts down each channel's timer and, when it expires, dispatches the channel's next entry through a table, and it calls three helpers for channels with an additional timer set.

name: set_audio_channel_registers
description: Writes a clamped volume, a period and a start address with a length into the register block of one audio channel, selected by an index. When no start address is set it stores a callback address and a length of one.

name: set_pointer_and_unit_length
description: Stores a routine address in a record field and sets an adjacent word to one.

name: step_value_with_counters
description: Steps a 16-bit value in a record by one of two increments while counters run, clamps it at a stored limit, and writes the result to two fields.
